title: Resumable uploads and ZIP exports
summary: Uppy Dashboard and headless tus adapters with scoped resume, refreshed credentials, tusd ownership hooks, and bounded ZIP export.

profiles: Node 24.19.0; TypeScript build and six tests including a real tus-js-client transfer against a local HTTP fixture, zip.js round trips, and tusd hook adapter checks.
notes: Uppy Dashboard browser interactions and a deployed tusd/auth gateway/storage backend were not exercised.
The host must authenticate every upload resource request and persist quota/ownership/completion state; MIME and fingerprint checks are client hints.
